articles.summary: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. (Inland American) will host an earnings call and webcast to discuss its third quarter and year-to-date 2012 results on Wednesday, December 19, 2012 at 2:00 p.m. Central time. During the call, management will also review portfolio strategies and funds from operations (FFO) performance. Speakers will include Bob Parks, chairman of Inland American, Tom McGuinness, president of Inland American, and Jack Potts, principal financial officer of Inland American. The live webcast and presentation will be available on Inland Americans website at www.inlandamerican.com. Listeners should log in approximately 10 minutes in advance to ensure proper setup to receive the webcast. A replay will be available on the Inland American website following the webcast.
